sentences.en: I used to get yelled at for hogging the phone.
sentences.zh: 我过去常常因为霸占电话而被人骂。

sentences.en: He gets pissed off very easily and yells and screams.
sentences.zh: 他很容易生气，并且会大喊大叫。

sentences.en: If you want to yell at someone, yell at me.
sentences.zh: 如果你想骂人，就冲我来吧。

senses.zh: 叫喊, 号叫, 叫着说
